name: magicslides
description: Make designed presentations (PPTX, PDF, live link), docs, sheets and reels with MagicSlides. 161 templates; your agent writes, MagicSlides designs.

interface.longDescription: Turn anything you write with your agent into a designed presentation: pick from 161 templates, fill the slides, and get a present link plus PPTX and PDF downloads. Also makes docs, spreadsheets, meeting notes and short animated reels.
defaultPrompt: Make me a 7-slide pitch deck for my startup
